hotwire.add.heads_up: Heads up: a few of its changes only reach what the game sets up from now on, or after a restart: %s.
hotwire.add.next_start.where: Hotwire puts it in your mods/ folder when you close the game, so it's there the next time you play.
hotwire.add.next_start.undo: You can undo it any time from Pending tasks.
hotwire.advanced.title: Advanced
hotwire.first_open.title: Before you use Hotwire
hotwire.first_open.what: Hotwire changes mods while the game runs.
hotwire.first_open.work: Mods weren't built for that, so Hotwire does the work.
hotwire.first_open.report: If a mod misbehaves after Hotwire switched, added or updated it, report it to Hotwire, not its author.
hotwire.first_open.crash: A crash report says whether Hotwire was involved.
hotwire.add.not_here: Adding from the screen is not in this version yet.
hotwire.screen.drop_wait: Wait for this to finish, then drop the jar again.
hotwire.screen.drop_jar_only: Only a mod's .jar file can be added.
hotwire.update.cancelled: Cancelled: %s stays %s, and %s was removed from staging.
hotwire.pending.ignored: The old versions are off the list. Their jars stay in hotwire/replaced/.
hotwire.screen.pick_limit: You can pick up to %s mods at a time. Switch these first, then pick more.
hotwire.screen.pick_limit_stopped: You can pick up to %s mods at a time, so picking stopped there. Switch these first, then pick more.
hotwire.row.world_locked: Can't be done unless you're not in a world.
hotwire.setup.name_hint: Name this setup, then press Enter
hotwire.setup.deleted: Deleted '%s'. Nothing in the game changed.
hotwire.setup.name_prompt: Name this setup, then press Enter. Escape to cancel.
hotwire.setup.rename_prompt: New name for '%s'. Enter to save, Escape to cancel.
hotwire.setup.name_taken: Could not rename - there is already a setup called '%s'.
hotwire.pending.title: Pending tasks
hotwire.pending.none: Nothing is waiting for the next launch.
hotwire.pending.update_replacing: At close, %s goes into mods/ and %s into hotwire/replaced/.
hotwire.pending.copied: Added live, and %s was copied into mods/ so it starts with the game. Undo removes that copy.
hotwire.pending.revertable: %s is kept in hotwire/replaced/. Revert puts it back when you close the game.
hotwire.reopen.title.leave: Leave the server to finish this
hotwire.reopen.title.reopen: Reopen your world to finish this
hotwire.reopen.plan.leave: Hotwire leaves the server and makes the change. Join again whenever you like.
hotwire.reopen.plan.add: Hotwire saves your world, adds the mod, and opens your world again.
hotwire.reopen.plan.reopen: Hotwire saves your world and opens it again.
hotwire.reopen.plan.switch: Hotwire saves your world, makes the change, and opens your world again.
hotwire.reopen.safe.server: Nothing on the server is lost.
hotwire.reopen.safe.world: Your world is saved first, so nothing is lost.
hotwire.update.unreadable: That jar could not be read.
hotwire.panel.more_in_log: More is in the game's log.
hotwire.progress.taking_out: Taking it out of what other mods keep
hotwire.progress.looking: Looking through what other mods keep of it
hotwire.progress.reloading_models: Reloading textures and models (the game stops for a moment)
hotwire.progress.rebuilding_renderers: Rebuilding its renderers (the game stops for a moment)
hotwire.switch.turned_off: Turned off %s in %s, until the game closes.
hotwire.switch.failed_off: Couldn't turn off %s, so nothing changed: %s. The log has the details.
hotwire.switch.failed_on: Couldn't turn on %s, so nothing changed: %s. The log has the details.
hotwire.switch.partly_off: Partly off: %s still live. The report says what.
hotwire.switch.one_fault: 1 thing went wrong on the way. The report says what.
hotwire.switch.faults: %s things went wrong on the way. The report says what.
hotwire.refusal.protected_off: %s can't be turned off: the game needs it.
hotwire.refusal.protected_on: %s can't be turned on: the game needs it.
hotwire.refusal.breaks: %s can't come on while %s is on, because it says it breaks it.
hotwire.api.takes_along: Turning off %s would turn off %s too, so %s can't do it.
hotwire.switch.world_locked: In-world switching is off in Advanced: leave the world, then switch.
hotwire.update.changes_one: It changes 1 class while the game runs.
hotwire.update.changes: It changes %s classes while the game runs.
hotwire.update.shape_one: 1 of its classes changes in a way a running game cannot take.
hotwire.update.shape: %s of its classes change in a way a running game cannot take.
hotwire.update.patched_one: Mods that stay on patch 1 of its classes.
hotwire.update.patched: Mods that stay on patch %s of its classes.
hotwire.update.entrypoint_new: It starts up in new ways.
hotwire.update.tier.in_place: Changes the running mod in place, with no restart.
hotwire.update.tier.restart_mod: Restarting only this mod is not built yet, so the new version loads next time you start the game.
hotwire.update.tier.next_start: The new version loads next time you start the game.
hotwire.update.done_one: %s is %s now: 1 class changed in place.
hotwire.update.done: %s is %s now: %s classes changed in place.
hotwire.update.done_one_later: %s is %s now: 1 class changed in place, %s more as they load.
hotwire.update.done_later: %s is %s now: %s classes changed in place, %s more as they load.
hotwire.update.queued: %s %s is queued as a pending task: it runs when you close the game, putting the new jar in your mods folder and the running one in hotwire/replaced. Cancel it any time from Pending tasks.
hotwire.update.blocker.entrypoint: The new version adds the %s entrypoint %s.
hotwire.update.blocker.dependents: %s depend on it and stay on.
hotwire.update.blocker.unmet: The new version needs %s %s, which the game does not have.
hotwire.update.blocker.added: The mod was added while the game ran.
hotwire.update.blocker.updated: The mod was updated once already while the game ran.
hotwire.update.blocker.never: The game needs it running, so it updates when you close the game.
hotwire.update.blocker.shape: %s changes in a way a running class cannot take: %s
hotwire.update.blocker.patched: %s is patched by %s, which stay on.
hotwire.update.resources_one_now: 1 asset or data file differs, read at the next resource reload (F3+T).
hotwire.update.resources_now: %s asset and data files differ, read at the next resource reload (F3+T).
hotwire.update.resources_one_later: 1 asset or data file differs, read when the game starts with the new version.
hotwire.update.resources_later: %s asset and data files differ, read when the game starts with the new version.
hotwire.settings.in_world.auto.note: Hotwire decides for each mod, and says when one must wait.
hotwire.settings.in_world.off.note: Never inside a world; leave it first.
hotwire.settings.nested.auto.note: A mod's own parts go off and on with it.
hotwire.settings.nested.all.note: Every jar a mod carries goes with it.
hotwire.settings.nested.none.note: Jars a mod carries stay as they are.
hotwire.add.read_failed: %s cannot be added: reading it failed: %s
hotwire.add.nested_unreadable: %s cannot be added: a jar inside it could not be read: %s
hotwire.add.nested_unwritable: %s cannot be added: a jar inside it could not be written out: %s
hotwire.add.later.running: It changes parts of the game that are already running, so it can only go in when the game starts.
hotwire.add.later.library: It brings a newer version of a library the game already started with, so it can only go in when the game starts.
hotwire.add.opens: Opens %s members of game classes as they load
hotwire.add.opens_loaded: Opens %s members of game classes, %s on classes already loaded, which the mod's code reaches through Hotwire
hotwire.add.makes_refused: %s makes %s, which a world only takes when it opens. %s
hotwire.add.makes: Makes %s, which a world only takes when it opens: the world is saved, closed and opened again around the add
hotwire.add.makes_use_reopen: %s makes %s, which a world only takes when it opens: add it with Save and add, which saves the world, adds it and opens the world again.
hotwire.reopen.single_player_only: Save and add works in a single-player world; on a server, add it at the title screen.
hotwire.reopen.lan: This world is open to LAN, so it cannot be closed for the add; close it to LAN or add the mod at the title screen.
hotwire.reopen.add_failed: Save and add could not finish: %s
hotwire.reopen.not_reopened: The world did not open again (%s). Open it from the world list.
hotwire.switch.no_instrument: Hotwire can't change classes in this game: %s
hotwire.reopen.why.off_server: These can't turn off while you're on this server.
hotwire.reopen.why.on_server: These can't turn on while you're on this server.
hotwire.reopen.why.off_world: These can't turn off while your world is open.
hotwire.reopen.why.on_world: These can't turn on while your world is open.
hotwire.report.crash_last: Hotwire wrote a report about the last crash
hotwire.report.crash: Hotwire wrote a report about the crash
hotwire.add.pick: Pick the mod's .jar file, or drop it onto this screen.
hotwire.update.pick: Pick the newer .jar file, or drop it onto this screen.
hotwire.add.world_open: It can't be added while your world is open.
hotwire.add.start_only: Part of it can only start together with the game.
hotwire.add.finishes_at_join: It's in. Part of it only starts when you join a world, so it finishes at your next join.
hotwire.screen.no_picker: No file picker opened on this system. Drop the .jar file onto this screen instead.
hotwire.self_change: Hotwire can't add, update or turn off itself while it runs: put the new jar in your mods folder and restart the game.
hotwire.off_code.world: It's off, but your world still holds things it made while it was on. Reopened, the world makes them without it.
hotwire.off_code.ran: %s is off, yet its code just ran: Hotwire could not take all of it out. %s
hotwire.off_code.ran_from: %s is off, yet its code just ran (reached from %s): Hotwire could not take all of it out. %s
hotwire.off_code.reopen: Saving and reopening the world clears what the world holds of it; a restart clears all.
hotwire.crash.title: Hotwire caught a crash
hotwire.crash.off_held: %s is off, yet code of it the game still held crashed; Hotwire kept the game going. A restart clears it. %s
hotwire.crash.turned_off: %s crashed, so Hotwire turned it off; the game goes on. %s
hotwire.crash.not_turned_off: %s crashed and could not be turned off: %s %s
hotwire.own_fault.title: Hotwire caught a fault of its own
hotwire.own_fault: Hotwire's own code failed inside the game, which went on past it: %s. Restarting the game is the safe way on. %s
hotwire.report.written: The report is at %s; send that one file.
hotwire.report.failed: The report could not be written: %s
hotwire.update.also: Also updates %s to %s, which it carries.
hotwire.picker.title: Add a mod
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.hotwire: Adds, removes and updates Fabric mods while the game runs.
